title: ESI DSL artifact
description: A stored ESI DSL artifact (ADR-0002): the A2UI v0.9 updateComponents component list plus the columns and SELECT it is bound to. It never contains row values or layout.

dslSchemaVersion.description: Version of the artifact format; see DSL_SCHEMA_VERSIONS in versions.ts for the A2UI pair it maps to.

protocolVersion.description: A2UI message version used when the artifact is rendered.

catalogId.description: The pinned basic catalog id, verbatim from catalog.json.

columns.description: Columns of the bound query result that the components may reference.

sql.description: The SELECT the artifact is bound to.

name.description: Column key as returned by the query; used as a JSON Pointer segment, so '/' and '~' are not allowed.
